description: This is a Python source file that provides functions for seeding a database from JSON files, including reading files, normalizing data, resolving paths, and upserting roles, competencies, and role-competency relationships into the database. It also includes a public function to perform the seeding process if enabled via environment variables.

methods.name: str _resolve_ingestion_dir(dir_setting: str)
methods.description: Resolves the ingestion directory path, supporting '~', relative paths, and fallback to project root.
